title: spec-shape-gate: all five entries in spec-shape-retirements.json name closed objectui cards and match nothing on main, so the registry's own rule says delete them
body:
Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (seat post #6023) · `os-warren` · session `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, closing #25055. Cross-repo rule 3: a linked chore gets a card, not memory. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What holds

`scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json`'s `$comment` says each entry is "deleted when that card closes". On `main` at `5050442bb9`, every one of its five entries names a downstream card that is closed `completed`:

| entry (objectstack PR) | downstream card | closed |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #23836 | objectstack-ai/objectui#12654 | 2026-10-16 |
| #23846 | objectstack-ai/objectui#12711 | 2026-10-16 |
| #24442 | objectstack-ai/objectui#13022 | 2026-10-19 |
| #24970 | objectstack-ai/objectui#13308 | 2026-10-21 (objectstack-ai/objectui#13312) |
| #24778 | objectstack-ai/objectui#13309 | 2026-10-21 (objectstack-ai/objectui#13311) |

The hourly `schedule` run `39588090692` (objectstack `5050442bb9`, objectui `78bd6d732b`) concludes `success` with `COMPILE_STATUS: 0`, and it lists all five as "matched nothing in this run".

## Why it matters

A stale entry is not inert. Entry B (#24778) matches any `TS2344` "Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true'." in `packages/data-objectstack/src/spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts`, and the three earlier entries carry the same per-file shape. While an entry stays, a NEW break in one of those files with the same code and message reads `known` instead of red. That is the masking the registry header forbids ("never become an ignore-all switch").

## Done when

- The five entries are deleted from `scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json` on `main`, leaving `"retirements": []`. `parseRegistry` accepts an empty array (`Array.isArray(doc.retirements)` only).
- The PR's own path-filtered `Spec Shape Gate` run concludes `success`, with no "matched nothing" list.
- Precedent: PR #23822 (the closed objectstack-ai/objectui#12325 entry).

Dedupe: open issues and PRs touching `spec-shape-retirements` — none (read at 2026-10-21T11:11Z: no open PR lists the file).
